## Problem

Describe the user problem and why this change is needed.

## Change

Describe the behavior changed and what remains out of scope.

## Verification

List exact tests or manual checks and their results.

## Risk

Cover privacy, account isolation, source rights, external API cost, and regulated-advice boundaries where relevant.

## Checklist

- [ ] No credentials, personal data, private URLs, or generated local state are included.
- [ ] User-facing text is localized.
- [ ] Relevant tests were added or updated.
- [ ] Unverified limitations are stated explicitly.
